newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn, wheat values steady.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn, wheat values steady.

text.p: FOB Gulf basis values for corn and winter wheat basis values were mostly unchanged, while nearby soybean values were narrowly mixed in light dealings, grain dealers said.
A lack of sizable pending export tenders kept business in export grain and soybean markets light.

Rumors that China was seeking 200,000 tonnes of U.S. soybeans could not be confirmed by exporters. However, exporters said they expect China to buy soybeans soon when prices drop as the U.S. harvest progresses.
Dealers quoted the following afternoon FOB U.S. Gulf values, basis Chicago futures, except hard red winter wheat basis Kansas City. (In cents per bushel).
